attributes.provenance: src/game/ui/select.c do_player_select and setup_sel_menu (worktree GDL-Claude-SelectDefake2, work_claim.select-defake2.20260830.v1); attempt.select-defake-tu.20260830.v2, superseding wave-1's attempt.select-defake-tu.20260830.v1 which recorded both caps.
attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family; boundary refinement of claim.law.offsetof-fused-immediate-counter and claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing - applies when a prior attempt regressed converting a field on a heavily-multi-field-touching or high-site-count base pointer and the exact form of that prior attempt (typed alias vs repeated cast) was not recorded.

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: Two independent prior caps in this exact TU, both predating the offsetof-fused-immediate-counter/multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing laws, were fully overturned by re-attempting with the offsetof-on-raw-pointer form (offsetof(Type,field) added to the ORIGINAL untyped pointer, never a typed struct alias or repeated inline cast) at MUCH larger scale than either law's original evidence: (1) do_player_select (1885 insns): wave-1 recorded 'motion_state alone -> real1096->1807' from an unrecorded prior form; the offsetof form converted ALL 57 motion_state sites plus 8 other Player fields (130 sites total in the whole function) with real held at exactly 1096 throughout, then a further 65 sites (VmuMenuEntry/OptMenuLayout/BlitEntry-array) also held real at 1096. (2) setup_sel_menu (123 insns): wave-1 recorded a full 18-site typed 'SelMenuBlock' struct alias regressing real82->100 (and a scalar-only subset ->96); the offsetof form (additive '712 + offsetof(OptMenuLayout, field)' on the SAME 'data + playerOffset' / 'field' raw pointers, since the typed struct was never verified/named and 'field' itself is a 1-site lwzu-adjacent local) converted all 18 sites with real held at 82. Consequence: a prior cap recorded WITHOUT the exact failing form documented (typed alias vs repeated cast vs offsetof) should not be treated as ruling out offsetof-on-raw-pointer, even at high per-field site counts (50+) or on functions with previously-catastrophic regressions (real +300 to +700) from an unknown prior form - re-attempt with pure offsetof before accepting the cap. This also means large single-field batches (e.g. all 57 sites of one field in one shot) do not need to be pre-emptively bisected into smaller groups when no typed alias is introduced; claim.law.large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression's bisection advice remains necessary above the ~4000-insn fuzzy-arbitration threshold or when a typed alias/cast IS used, but was not needed here (fndiff --count's real/insns were checked every batch and never moved).
